lines.en: Metatron stared at the ruined conference chamber. The Demon Kings and archangels who had held weapons only moments ago now lay strewn about.
Stories of Good and Evil scattering.
The effects of Chaos exceeding its critical point were reaching inside the gray sphere.
One of the angels still conscious reached toward him.
[Scribe……]
With a crunch, Michael’s rear foot crushed the angel’s head. Kicking aside the dead angel, Michael pulled out the child-sized archangel he had hidden against his chest.
The unconscious archangel dangled from Michael’s grasp.
[Should I kill Raphael, too? It feels a little wasteful to let him go like this……]
[You may spare him if you wish. Chaos has reached its limit.]
[Then what about that Demon King?]
Metatron looked toward the edge of the sphere, where a fierce exchange still raged. Agares stood there, his entire body in tatters.

Asmodeus and the other ‘Seekers of the End’ were attacking together, but the Demon King Agares had yet to fall. With Stories streaming from his entire body and a vengeful spirit’s hatred etched into his eyes.
Even amid that fierce battle, Agares still held cigarettes between his lips. Not just one, but several.
[The stigma ‘One Ciggie for Herculean Strength Lv.???’ is active.]
[The stigma ‘One Ciggie for Agility Lv.???’ is active.]
[The stigma ‘One Ciggie for Magic Power Lv.???’ is active.]
It was Agares’s stigma, [Universal Cigarette].
The specialty of Agares, a longtime chain-smoker. A stigma unique to Agares, harboring a Story that overclocked his incarnation body’s performance.
Watching Agares withstand a combined attack from no fewer than five or six Demon Kings, Asmodeus said,
[Indeed, the fame of the ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’ is well earned. But how long can you hold on?]
Without replying, Agares took out a fresh cigarette and lit it.
Metatron and Michael were approaching him across the now-cleared battlefield.
Agares said,
[Metatron. Think again. This cannot preserve Good and Evil. What meaning is there in being remembered after everyone is annihilated?]
[If we are remembered, we may someday be resurrected.]
[Resurrected? Like that damned fallen angel?]
Michael frowned.
[The Demon King ‘King of Corrupted Angels’ releases his Status!]
Agares retreated, shedding Stories before Michael’s stormlike Status.
Yet his gaze remained fixed on Metatron.
[What use is clinging to life that way? That would not be us. Resurrected like that, we would not be ‘Metatron’ or ‘Agares,’ merely the ‘Scribe of Heaven’ and the ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’!]
[That is who we are, Ruler of Eastern Hell.]
Ancient Stories flowed behind Metatron.
They were Stories he had read, he had lived, and he had believed in.
[The oldest Good smiles.]
That was the ‘Scribe of Heaven.’
The one who recorded this world’s Good.
The being who decided what was Good, and served as its standard.
Looking at his longtime nemesis, Agares, too, felt the Story flowing leisurely beside him.
[The Most Ancient Evil tilts its head.]
It was the long history of Evil he had followed.
A history of opposing Good, being excluded, and being punished.
At that moment, Agares felt thousands of years of his life condensed into a single comma.
This flow would never end.
As long as the ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell’ lived and the ‘Scribe of Heaven’ existed. As long as they opposed one another and repeated their wars.
Even if Metatron and Agares died, others would become the ‘Scribe of Heaven’ and the ‘Ruler of Eastern Hell.’
[If that’s what passes for Good and Evil……]
Spitting phlegm onto the floor, Agares smiled bitterly.
[Then I quit being Evil.]
A cigarette flew from his fingertips.
The cigarette spinning through the air, trailing smoke.
Asmodeus shouted urgently,
[Stop him!]
Swirling smoke enveloped Agares’s body.
[The stigma ‘One Ciggie for Cowardice Lv.???’ activates!]
Whitish smoke exploded, and attacks rained down.
When the smoke cleared, only a single cigarette remained, rolling across the floor. The Seekers of the End withdrew their weapons in dismay.
Metatron looked down at the cigarette on the floor. Acrid smoke from the still-burning cigarette lingered in the air.
His rival was gone. Good was now alone.
Was this loneliness, or a kind of liberation? Metatron could not tell.
Someone stamped out the discarded cigarette butt.
[The Most Ancient Evil takes an interest in a new Evil.]
He looked up to find Asmodeus smiling coyly.
[How unfortunate. I had intended to take Agares’s ‘Wall.’]
Looking at him, Metatron said,
[You will have it soon.]
At any rate, their immediate objective had been achieved.
[Current Chaos: 100]
Chaos had reached its limit, and the Apocalypse Dragon had entered its resurrection sequence.
Destruction would soon begin.
[The conference chamber is collapsing.]
As the gray sphere surrounding the chamber crumbled, archangels’ corpses began to fall toward the ground.
Apparently enjoying the sight, Asmodeus asked,
[But is this really all right?]
Metatron remained silent. The time for debating what was all right had passed long ago. Watching the falling angels, he offered the most textbook answer.
[Everything is the will of Good. To reach the most ideal ■■……]
The wish of all constellations, and the place where a star’s story ended.
Asmodeus said,
[■■…… Constellations pursuing such things do seem to end up alike. You really resemble someone I know. Though your dispositions are complete opposites.]
Just as Metatron was about to ask who, he heard a dragon’s howl tearing through the sky.
Grrraaaaaah—!
There seemed to be several thousand dragons at least, darting through the sky in fierce combat. Explosions sounded without cease. Dragons with torn wings plummeted to the ground.
It was not the scene Metatron had expected.
……The Apocalypse Dragon had not yet been resurrected?
[Why so surprised? We aren’t the only ones pursuing ■■.]
Asmodeus smiled at a man looking up at them from the ground.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ roars!]
The Abyssal Black Flame Dragon was strong.
Tearing apart dozens of dragons filling the sky in a single rush, he soared upward, displaying his presence with truly domineering Status.
As expected of one of the strongest constellations in ‘Ways of Survival.’
Thrilled by her sponsor’s performance, Han Sooyoung waved her bandages and shouted,
“For the first time, I’m proud of you, Black Flame Dragon! Kill them all!”
“You can do it, Chimera Dragon!”
Hands clasped tightly, Shin Yoosung was also gazing up at the sky with an earnest expression.
[The presence of the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ grows stronger!]
[The presence of the ‘Chimera Dragon’ grows stronger!]
Each time the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon and Chimera Dragon defeated another dragon, their standing rose. Watching that magnificent battle made even my heart pound wildly.
I looked away from the dragons and signaled Yoo Joonghyuk with my eyes.
“Understood.”
Receiving my signal, he moved with the others.
His task was to contact the nearby nebulae before the Apocalypse Dragon began to act.
And I had something to do, too.
Studying the dragons in the air one by one, I thought.
This was not the Apocalypse Dragon’s first resurrection.
Somewhere among those dragons would probably be the previous ‘Apocalypse Dragon.’
[Several members of the Dragon King species have noticed your presence.]
“Oh, dear.”
Kraaaaaash!

I reflexively activated [Electrification] and blocked the breath. Several members of the Dragon King species glared at me, then tilted their heads and flew away, as though they had seen something strange.
……What was their problem? I wasn’t a dragon.
Then a message appeared.
[You are eligible to participate in the ‘Dragon Festival.’]
……What?
[Would you like to participate in the ‘Dragon Festival’?]
The sudden message left me dumbfounded.
I might be a constellation, but I wasn’t a dragon. Why was I getting this……?
“Why do you not participate?”
……When had someone come up beside me?
Keeping my guard up, I turned.
A beautiful human of indeterminate gender stood there. Brilliantly shining red hair. I sensed no powerful Status, but there was something mysterious about their appearance.
……A reincarnator?
It was possible.
This island held a very small number of experts hiding their strength, like Yoo Hoseong, the One Invincible Fist.
“I asked why you do not participate.”
“I don’t know what you mean, but I’m not qualified.”
“Why? Do you not possess a dragon’s heart as well?”
Only then did I realize.
[The Story fragment ‘Broken Heart of a Young Gold Dragon’ stirs!]
Come to think of it, my heart belonged to a Gold Dragon.
A Story fragment I had absorbed at the ‘Story Horizon.’
[The Story fragment ‘Broken Heart of a Young Gold Dragon’ wishes to participate in the Dragon Festival.]
I had wondered why my heart kept pounding so fiercely…… So that was it.
The reincarnator asked,
“If you are truly a dragon, you should be angry at this situation.”
“……What situation would that be?”
“Great dragons being used as mere material for scenarios.”
It felt as though my wildly beating heart was very slowly growing cold.
The reincarnator continued.

“Good and Evil, communication, reincarnation…… Amid the <Star Stream>’s great themes, dragons have been used endlessly. If you, too, are a dragon, enter the festival. Become the Final Dragon that enacts the revelation, and contribute to the world’s destruction. Witness the end of the scenarios that robbed you of your existence.”
I studied the reincarnator closely.
Good and Evil, communication, reincarnation…… A reincarnator who had lived long enough could have experienced all those themes of the <Star Stream>.
If they had lived a very, very long time.
After a moment’s thought, I said,

“Not every story in the scenarios is a string of misfortunes. There are things we could discover because the scenarios existed. You may not know, having stayed only on Reincarnation Island, but the scenarios are changing.”
I hated myself for saying it. Even so, I meant about half of it.
In the distance, I could see Yoo Joonghyuk and the others contacting the constellations.
Watching the same scene, the reincarnator said,
“Changing? How have they changed? Can dragons and monsters now become the protagonists of Stories?”
“Stories like that already exist.”
“But they aren’t popular, are they?”
“There are popular ones, too. There have been in the past. You know them, don’t you? In 「The Song of the Nibelungs」 or 「The Legend of Saint George」……”
“The dragons weren’t the protagonists of those.”
A few dragons lost their way in the air, collided, and fell.
The reincarnator continued.

“Dragons have always been hunted. Called the source of all evil, they were shabby villains who abducted human princesses or hoarded gold. It seems ridiculous now. Why should a dragon care about gold or the females of another species?”
“Those aren’t the only stories. There are plenty of scenarios where dragons go into the human world and enjoy themselves. For example—”
“‘A dragon Polymorphed into a beautiful human.’ Do you consider that a pure dragon?”
I could say nothing. The reincarnator continued.
“Even tens of thousands of years ago, dragons served the same purpose. In the end, those scenarios were for other species. For constellations.”
With every word, an ominous Status flowed from the reincarnator’s voice.
“Not one scenario treated a dragon as a dragon. Dragons were always consumed, defined, and made into targets to conquer. Things will not be much different now.”
Little by little, breathing grew difficult. The air around us was changing.
Status strong enough to bind me, a Narrative-grade constellation. The Abyssal Black Flame Dragon, roaring in the sky, was flying toward us.
Looking at him, I said,
“I’ll change it.”
“You? How?”
“I won’t make dragons unhappy ever again.”
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ looks at you.]
The stars’ gazes were gathering.
[The overwhelming majority of constellations look at you.]
[Many constellations are horrified by the being beside you!]
The reincarnator looked at me expressionlessly.
“Interesting.”
The reincarnator’s appearance began to change.
Polymorph.
The magic favored by dragons who enjoyed playing in the world.
“Tens of thousands of years ago, a dokkaebi made me the same offer. They said they would create a world where dragons could be the masters of scenarios.”
My vision seemed to go dark. My senses would not obey me. My dimming sight shook wildly, and Stories poured from my nose.
Shin Yoosung, who had been cheering, collapsed like a puppet with severed strings. Han Sooyoung was looking at me, blood pouring from her mouth and nose.
Through a ringing that threatened to burst my eardrums, I heard her message.
—Kim, Dokja, what, is going on……
My hands and feet shook uncontrollably.
Collapsed on the ground, I struggled to raise my head.
Could something like this even be called ‘Status’?
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ tells you to run!]
[The constellation ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’ looks at you in alarm!]
[The constellation ‘Father of the Rich Night’……!]
Fathomless dragon speech (龍言) surged into my ears.
[The dokkaebi who deceived me became the 「Dokkaebi King」.]
The sun vanished, and someone’s shadow covered the world.
The dragon of the end. The Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation finally spread its wings of calamity.
[The ‘Fourth Wall’ reacts violently!]
The previous Apocalypse Dragon took flight, raising a storm of Stories.
As my vision wavered precariously, I swayed like a scarecrow that had lost its support.

Soaring into the sky in an instant, the dragon cried out, and every sound in the world fell asleep. Incarnation bodies’ heads burst, and constellations on the battlefield covered their ears, spilling Stories.
Tssssss……
A pitch-black hole gaped in the sky where the Apocalypse Dragon had passed.
Panicking dragons fled in terror, while those foolish enough to attack were grazed by its wings and reduced to bloody pulp.
At the center of that sky, the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon awaited it.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ looks at his opponent.]
Roaring, the Black Flame Dragon charged.
The two dragons tangled, and a fierce battle broke out in the air.
In truth, it was less a fierce battle than a fight between an adult and a fifteen-year-old.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ is furious!]
The Black Flame Dragon was several times larger than the other dragons, yet before the Apocalypse Dragon, even he looked like a hatchling.
“Don’t lose! I’ll kill you if you lose!”
Stories flowed from Han Sooyoung’s body as she cheered for her sponsor. Her Giant Stories were speaking for him.
“Destruction’s apocalypse! The abyss of the abyss! I’ll say stuff like that as many times as you want, so don’t lose! Please!”
As though answering her, the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon unleashed his breath.
Dragons struck by it fell like burning kites. Black flames seemed to blanket the entire sky.
[A strong dragon. Before I fell asleep, there was no being like you.]
[Stop babbling, old-timer. I didn’t manifest just to hear that condescending crap.]
[It seems your manners need correcting.]
Dodging the breath with a wingbeat, the Apocalypse Dragon countered with its own. There was no time to evade it.
Whoooosh—
The Black Flame Dragon escaped through quick thinking. Instantly transforming into a fifteen-year-old boy, he used Dragon-language magic to cast [Meteor Strike].
Struck by fragments of falling meteors, the Apocalypse Dragon grew furious.
[……Polymorph? You are no different, after all.]
[Bullshit! You Polymorphed just now yourself, old-timer.]
[It is something a pure dragon must never do.]
Growling, the Black Flame Dragon returned to his original form and shouted,
[I’ll live however I want! Human, orc, whatever I become, it’s my choice!]
[You are unfit to represent all dragons.]
Sparks flying as they bit and clawed in fierce combat.
Silently taking the Black Flame Dragon’s attacks, the Apocalypse Dragon slowly opened its mouth. The Black Flame Dragon immediately gathered his breath, too.
Breath against breath.
Dense black flames collided with the Apocalypse Dragon’s crimson blaze.
In the next instant, the sky changed color all at once.
Heat as though the sun stood before our eyes.
It was a magnificent sight, but no one could admire it.
Unable to withstand the heat, reincarnators turned to ash with those mesmerizing flames engraved upon their eyes.
[The Giant Story ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’ has chosen the ‘Final Dragon.’]
The Abyssal Black Flame Dragon had been the candidate closest to the ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’ here. But conversely, that meant he was not yet the ‘Final Dragon.’
[The winner of the ‘Dragon Festival’ has been decided.]
Something fell limply from beneath the red clouds.
“Black Flame Dragon!”
The Black Flame Dragon, his wing membranes ablaze and his body torn all over.
As he fell, the Black Flame Dragon’s eyes spoke to me in frustration.
「Ah, was fighting with only one hand too much after all……? I leave the rest to you, boy.」
Events were unfolding just as in the original I knew.
The previous Apocalypse Dragon—a being with the power of a mature Myth-grade constellation.
Now it would evolve once more into a calamity far beyond even that Status.
After spitting up a bowlful of blood, Han Sooyoung demanded,
“Fuck…… Kim Dokja! What is this? This isn’t your plan!”
“It’s following the original.”
“What does that mean? Is it going well or not?”
Yoo Joonghyuk’s message came from behind us.
—I’ve called everyone I could, Kim Dokja.
Constellations were gathering behind him.
All of them gazed at the sky, stunned.
Ruuumble!
The <Star Stream>’s probability was gathering around the dragon’s massive body, which had swallowed the world’s light.
[What on earth is that……]

The Apocalypse Dragon’s resurrection had already been decided. Scenarios needed events, and the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’ was an event in itself. As long as the will of the <Star Stream> demanded an event, the Apocalypse Dragon’s resurrection was predetermined.
There had been various attempts to prevent it in the original. Not one had succeeded.

Even so, I had lingered here searching for the previous Apocalypse Dragon. Discussed the Stories of dragons. And the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon had sacrificed his Status to prolong a losing fight. All of it…… had been to buy time.
[The Giant Story ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’ begins its storytelling!]
With a hum, the smartphone inside my coat began to glow.
「In the hottest place in hell, the calamity of the Book of Revelation has opened its eyes」
Apparently, the Apocalypse Dragon’s resurrection was foretold even in the final version tls123 had sent.
「Dragons who lost their lives within arduous Stories roar」
「And now the season of the crimson end shall come」
Fallen dragons cried out in anguish. Countless dragons, sacrificed within Stories, robbed even of their souls and stuffed into names, paid homage to their king.
I could see Metatron and Asmodeus across the sky. The battle in the conference chamber seemed to have just ended.
Looking up at the Apocalypse Dragon’s enormous body, Metatron said,
[You have come. Evil Dragon of Harmagedon……]
The evil dragon of the Giant Story 「Harmagedon」. Once an embodiment of Evil, a primordial Evil whose weight even the Most Ancient Evil could not bear.
That evil dragon looked haughtily down upon the constellations of Good and Evil.
[Old Stories. It is time to fulfill the promise of destruction.]
The air exploded violently as the Apocalypse Dragon’s massive body pierced the atmosphere.
Enormous sparks erupted beyond the sky where it had disappeared.
[The main scenario is being updated!]
[The calamity’s probability has exceeded the scenario’s limits.]
[The scenario difficulty is being automatically adjusted.]
[A scenario appropriate to the calamity’s difficulty will be reassigned.]
I had expected this. If I remembered correctly, the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’ was the calamity of the eighty-fifth main scenario in the original. And the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons’ was the eightieth.
[A scenario leap has occurred!]
[The calamity’s difficulty is abnormally high.]
[Abnormalities have occurred in incarnation bodies due to the excessive scenario leap.]
[The eighty-ninth main scenario begins.]
<Main Scenario #89 — Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation>
Category: Main
Difficulty: Unmeasurable
Clear Conditions: Stop the ‘Calamity of the Book of Revelation.’
Time Limit: This scenario has no time limit.
Reward: A Giant Story related to the ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation,’ ???
Failure: The destruction of the <Star Stream> will accelerate.
● This scenario is divided into phases. Refer to the system messages and prepare for the calamity.
With a heavy heart, I read the scenario message.
……The eighty-ninth scenario.
The scenario number was even later than in the original.
The later the scenario, the more probability it permitted.
In other words, the Apocalypse Dragon descending now would be stronger than in the original.
[A calamity warning sounds throughout the <Star Stream>!]
[The resurrected Apocalypse Dragon will soon begin to act.]
[All regions of the <Star Stream> are subject to scenario 89.]
“Dokja-ssi. We’ve brought everyone.”
I turned to see Jung Heewon, <Kim Dokja’s Company>, and the constellations following us.
Beings who had been fighting each other only hours ago. Allies Yoo Joonghyuk had assembled while the Black Flame Dragon and I bought time.
[Sorry. I couldn’t gather as many as I’d hoped.]
Looking embarrassed, Dionysus scratched the back of his head. The gods of <Olympus> stood arrayed behind him.
The Goddess of Love and Beauty, Aphrodite.
The Atrocious God of War, Ares.
The Spokesman of Justice and Wisdom, Athena.
The Master of the Skywalk, Hermes.
The Volcanic Blacksmith, Hephaestus.
The Pure Hunter of the Moonlight, Artemis……
All of them had created <Gigantomachia> with us.
[I tried contacting Father and the fish ajusshi, too……]

Zeus, the ‘Lightning Throne,’ and Poseidon, the ‘Spear that Parts the Boundaries of the Sea,’ had apparently not joined. Considering the might those Myth-grade constellations had shown in <Gigantomachia>, it was a shame.
[This isn’t enough, is it?]
“To be honest…… no.”
<Olympus> was powerful, but they could not stop the Apocalypse Dragon alone.
If the ‘First Tail-Flick’ was as described in the original, our current force would struggle to withstand even its first shockwave.
Then someone’s True Voice rang out.
[My former comrades say they will help, too, Demon King of Salvation.]
Dazzling light rose in the northern sky.
[The constellations of the nebula <Vedas> have manifested in the scenario!]
Constellations appeared through the dark clouds, accompanied by mesmerizing flames. The moment I saw them, pages of ‘Ways of Survival’ turned in my head.
Beings I had expected to meet someday, though never like this.
The ‘God-King of Yakshas (夜叉神王),’ Kubera.
‘Purifying Flames,’ Agni.
And ‘Unending Storm,’ Vayu.
All were Narrative-grade constellations who had belonged to <Vedas>’ ‘Lokapalas’ alongside Surya, the ‘Supreme God of Light.’
[Where is this Apocalypse Dragon?]
[An opportunity to gain a decent Story. It’s been a while.]
[Indra’s injuries were too severe for him to come.]
That was the beginning.
[The constellations of the nebula <Papyrus> have manifested in the scenario!]
From the eastern sky.
[The constellations of the nebula <Guardian Tree> have manifested in the scenario!]
Then from the western sky.
[The constellations of the nebula <Asgard> have manifested in the scenario!]
[The constellations of the nebula <Twelve Zodiacs> have manifested in the scenario!]
Constellations who had once been enemies gathered one by one before the <Star Stream>’s calamity.
Amid the manifestation of those dazzling stars, Yoo Joonghyuk, Han Sooyoung, and the rest of <Kim Dokja’s Company> stood close beside me. They all looked tense.
“There’s no need to be intimidated. We’re one of them now, too.”
The way the constellations looked at us had indeed changed. When <Kim Dokja’s Company> was first formed, their gazes had been closer to contempt or disdain. Now they were closer to envy.
<Kim Dokja’s Company> had come this far by its own strength.
And by our own strength, we would advance to the ‘Final Scenario.’
When even the constellations from the regional battlefields who had yet to join the main battlefield arrived, our numbers rose well past five hundred.
But there was something wrong with the newcomers’ heads.
[A Giant Story for one measly dragon? What a bargain.]
[Everyone, get lost. Our nebula will hunt the Apocalypse Dragon.]
[No, our <Guardian Tree> will hunt it.]
[Surya, will you give us a ride to that Apocalypse Dragon?]
Surya looked incredulous.
[You’re insane. Did you not see what just happened?]
[Oh, we saw it. That strange bit of scenario staging.]
The speaker was Vakarine, the ‘Morning Star Goddess,’ who had just arrived from a regional battlefield.
[There’s no way a mere monster could possess such Status, Surya. Have you been short of coins since leaving <Vedas>?]
[That wasn’t an act—]
[Our train driver seems frightened. Let’s go conquer it ourselves.]
Not every constellation in the <Star Stream> knew the Apocalypse Dragon.
Its resurrection had taken place tens of thousands of years ago.
Some myths were ancient history even to constellations.
Enough time for those who had lived through the calamity, and those born afterward, to forget it.
Metatron spoke in warning.
[Everyone, calm down. Acting independently would be troublesome. That Apocalypse Dragon—]
[You stay out of it. Your actions wiped out the entire Story of the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons.’]
As though on cue, system messages appeared.
[The ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation’ has begun to act!]
<First Phase Warning>
—The ‘First Tail-Flick’ will begin in 3 minutes.
—The ‘First Tail-Flick’ is a resurrection calamity (復活災害) of the Apocalypse Dragon.
—The ‘First Tail-Flick’ will devastate one quarter of the <Star Stream>.
One quarter of the <Star Stream> would be devastated.
The information about this phase was truly staggering.
Yet the constellations reading the scenario message still seemed doubtful.
[A quarter will die? The Bureau knows how to joke.]
[Those dokkaebis are getting better at bluffing.]
Most of the constellations here were more accustomed to watching scenarios than participating in them.
Beings who exploited others’ stories to find comfort for their own lives.
They were the dokkaebis’ customers, so they believed the Bureau would never create a scenario that would annihilate them all.
But they did not yet know.
That some stories in this world made even the audience subject to a scenario.
The constellations leaped in unison toward the Apocalypse Dragon, which was gathering its strength beyond the atmosphere.
[The Giant Story is ours!]
Greed shone in their eyes.
「Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation」—the scenario replacing the ‘Great War of Saints and Demons.’
If they could defeat the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’ here, they would gain the strongest ‘Giant Story.’
Perhaps growing anxious at this, the constellations from the nebulae already present leaped toward the atmosphere, too.
[The constellation ‘Morning Star Goddess’ releases her Status!]
[The constellation ‘God-King of Yakshas’ releases his Status!]
The first to advance were Vakarine, the ‘Morning Star Goddess,’ and Kubera, the ‘God-King of Yakshas.’
[The nebula <Guardian Tree> allocates probability to its constellations!]
[The nebula <Vedas> allocates probability to its constellations!]
My companions looked increasingly anxious as the constellations receded.
“Shouldn’t we go, too?”
“Absolutely not.”
I spoke emphatically. Apart from those who had rushed in like moths to a flame, most of the older constellations stayed put, as we did. They knew the outcome of this fight.
I asked Metatron, who was watching as though he had done nothing wrong,
“Metatron. Are you going to make the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’s sealing device’?”
He looked down at me and smiled gently.
[Of course. After all, it was done in the 1863rd round, too. Evil has come to the world. Must we not save everyone now?]

As though he had forgotten that we had been trying to kill one another mere hours ago, his eyes shone with an almost holy light. I had sensed something strange about him before, but seeing him now, he really seemed insane.
“If that plan succeeds, you’ll lose your life, too. Then ‘Good’ will disappear from the world.”
[I will disappear. Good will not.]
It felt like talking to a brick wall. Shaking my head, I turned away.
Behind me, the ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon,’ now as small as Biyoo, was being petted by Han Sooyoung. Exhausted, he breathed a little flame into the air.
Han Sooyoung said,
“Kim Dokja.”
“What?”
“You haven’t told us something, have you?”
I hesitated briefly, then asked,
“What are you talking about?”
“It’s suspicious. Normally, you’d share all the information before starting…… Why haven’t you explained this scenario properly?”
Narrowing her eyes at me, she continued.
“There is a way to win, right?”
“There is.”
“Are you sure? You’re not planning to use some weird method again?”
“What weird method?”
Han Sooyoung sharply drew a finger across her throat.
I smiled and answered,
“Don’t worry. I won’t.”
But she looked far from convinced. Shin Yoosung added,
“Then why do you have that stigma on, ajusshi?”
[The stigma ‘Sacrificial Will Lv.8’ is active!]
The only stigma I had created displayed its message in the air, imbuing my companions with strength. Jung Heewon said,
“……Can’t you turn that off now? It’s been bothering me this whole time.”
“And why on earth is its level so high……?”
Lee Jihye grumbled, too. I spoke as if making an excuse.
“I only turned it on to amplify your strength. I really don’t have any strange ideas.”
Then Lee Gilyoung cut in.
“But that stigma only activates when you intend to sacrifice yourself for your companions.”
“You’re trying to trick us, aren’t you, ajusshi?”

Every phase of the ‘First Tail-Flick’ had to be suppressed early to minimize the damage. In the original, dozens of nebulae would already have been destroyed by now, and an eighth of the sky would have collapsed.
Now we would be given time to prepare for the next phase.
Ruuumble!
“Dokja-ssi! There!”
At Jung Heewon’s voice, I turned to see something flowing from the Apocalypse Dragon’s tail.
But the heat-wave phase had definitely ended, hadn’t it? This was impossible.
Metatron voiced my thoughts.
[Much faster than expected.]
[Scenario probability is being adjusted due to the intervention of a Myth-grade constellation.]
[The scenario’s probability accelerates the phases’ progression.]
[The ‘third phase’ begins in 30 seconds!]
As though trying to prevent the phase from beginning, Hades pressed the Apocalypse Dragon with his Status. Persephone and all the other constellations looked grave.
If the third phase began now, even Hades could not stop it.
Hades’s attributes were fire and darkness.
He was not suited to blocking the third shockwave.
I asked Metatron,
“How much longer will the seal take?”
[I do not know whether I can finish in time.]
A faint despair lingered on his face, too.
He was probably beginning to realize what he had done.
[I will buy time.]
The speaker was Michael, who had been conserving his Status all this time.
Perhaps spurred by Hades’s performance, he flapped his wings, releasing all his Status.
Half Good, half Evil.
Looking at the Stories lingering on Michael’s face, Metatron said,
[Demon King of Salvation, as you already know, only a being with the power of ‘Chaos’ can stop the third shockwave.]
The shockwave began to stir in the distance.
Strictly speaking, the two we had endured so far were not shockwaves, merely heralds of the ‘third.’ The shockwave we faced now was the true essence of the ‘First Tail-Flick.’
Metatron asked,
[Do you have anyone with the power of ‘Chaos’?]
I looked around at my companions and the constellations.
There was no point, really. Even Yoo Joonghyuk could not use the Chaos attribute.
Chaos was not an attribute, but an anti-attribute.
‘Chaos’ was not ordinarily a power permitted to constellations or Demon Kings.
[The power of the ‘Fruit of Good and Evil’ stirs within you.]
And I was both a constellation and a Demon King.
A being who could not be defined as either one.
A Demon King who had eaten the Fruit of Good and Evil.
[You should be capable of it.]
I nodded.
The essence of Chaos was anti-order. Breaking down two orders as I did, I should be able to counter its power.
Then someone grabbed my shoulder.
“I can do it, too.”
“Heewon-ssi?”
I could see rings of Chaos in Jung Heewon’s eyes. Her bleached-white hair floated within a mysterious, ominous aura.
At that moment, I realized what she had awakened into.
“Good. Let’s try.”
I looked up at the sky.

Actually, I had been searching the night sky for a certain constellation’s presence for some time, but could not find it. With that constellation’s help, we might manage somehow. I had built my plan around that—
[The ‘third phase’ begins!]
Apparently, this time it was too late.
[The Demon King ‘King of Corrupted Angels’ releases his Status!]
[The constellation ‘Savior of Corruption’ releases his Status!]
Two modifiers belonging to one being.
Revealing his true strength, Michael charged forward.
His Status was certainly enough to warrant his confidence.
[Judgement Field].
His signature technique, which he had once used to crush me, extended toward the shockwave of Chaos. An absolute wall of judgement blessed by God.
Kraaaaaash!
The invincible field shattered all too easily. Far from stopping the shockwave, it could not even buy time. Michael screamed as his [Judgement Field] broke like glass.
The calamity of scenario 89. The shockwave of Chaos, surpassing even that of the original, bore straight into Michael’s body, crushing it and tearing it apart.
Yoo Joonghyuk’s voice came from behind me.
“Dodge!”
He, too, seemed to have realized something. This shockwave was on an entirely different level from the previous two.
Having made up my mind, I was about to step forward when Jung Heewon blocked my path.
“Heewon-ssi.”
“Shut up. I knew you’d do this.”

As though she knew what I would do, she stood motionless with her back to me. Lee Hyunsung’s large body hung from her back. The face of someone who had fallen into a sleep of steel to protect another.
I spoke again.
“Heewon-ssi. If someone has to risk their life—”
“Don’t even hint at it. I’ll really lose my mind.”
[The Story ‘Demon King of Salvation’ begins its story.]
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ begins its story.]
As though sympathizing with that emotion, the two Stories began to speak.
Both Stories gained through similar experiences.
[The stigma ‘Sacrificial Will Lv.8’ is active!]
A stigma gained through a similar experience.
I knew how much pain it caused Jung Heewon.
Even so, I had to say it.
“If we can’t stop that here, Hyunsung-ssi really will die.”
I had to be crueler than anyone.
“There is a way to stop it. What would you do in my place, Heewon-ssi?”
“I don’t want to hear it. Please!”
When Jung Heewon turned, her eyes were red.
“You’ve got a way out again, haven’t you! I know! That’s the kind of person you are, Dokja-ssi. You’ve got some goddamned way that only you know about, and if you use it, you’ll die!”
“I think you’ve misunderstood something. I’m not going to die.”
She did not have [Lie Detection].
“Things are different now. You and the others aren’t the same as back then, either. I’m making this choice because I trust you. So.”
Turning my head, I said,
“Please make sure you save me, Heewon-ssi.”
The power of [Way of the Wind] and [Electrification] sent her flying backward.
“Kim Dok—”
Facing the shockwave now right in front of me, I shouted in my True Voice with all my strength.
[Surya!]
At my cry, a train rushed up from behind and picked me up. It had been hastily assembled and, oddly, consisted of nothing but the locomotive.
[Let’s go.]
I felt Surya’s Status sustaining the flow through my whole body as the train set off.
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ begins its storytelling!]
Fueled by a Giant Story, the train charged into battle.
Beyond the Story fragments, into the shockwave of Chaos.
Krrrraaack!
An impact hit me, as though my whole body were shattering, and fragments of the train flew through the air.
Within the storm, Michael’s half-ruined incarnation body was looking at me.
[You—]
I passed him and kept going. I felt my consciousness slipping away. The [Fourth Wall] sounded a warning, and every Story I possessed screamed.
I could not withstand this. Every Story cried out in unison that I would certainly die.
Beyond the shockwave that erased existence, I felt the Apocalypse Dragon’s gaze.
「You cannot stop me」
Feeling that gaze, I smiled.
That was right. I couldn’t stop you. You weren’t something that could be killed. You were ‘calamity’ itself. Something far beyond even constellations and Demon Kings.
A mere constellation like me could never oppose such a calamity. And
I knew another calamity like that.
[The constellations of the <Star Stream> realize your intentions and are horrified!]
[The constellations of the Final Scenario are appalled by your idea!]
[All dokkaebis of the Bureau—the scenario’s probability……]
Terrifying sparks swept through the air. Merely calling the name did this much. Detonating all the probability the constellations had pooled for me, I called someone’s name again.
A being no one invited into a scenario, even if they knew its true name.
Beyond the shockwave-filled sky, I could see the cosmos of the <Star Stream>.
The backlash created by disrupted probability was closing in.
Stars and nebulae were being erased as a vast dark mist (暗霧) advanced. A shudder swept through my mind. Beyond the seemingly endless fog, a huge eye stared this way.
I had seen it once in the seventy-third Demon Realm. That had been its avatar. This time, it was not.
[‘The Indescribable Distance’ looks down at the ‘Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation.’]
An Outer God born from Chaos.
The great calamity that had destroyed my Demon Realm was approaching Reincarnation Island.
